name: Unholy Hunter
description: 'Unholy Hunter' is Greg Porn at his darkest, and for now it exists only as a two-minute warning shot. Greg Porn cut the track as Ref 1.0 — supplied by Black, with the final mix and master plus artist clearance both still parked — and the reference form only sharpens the effect. There is no polish to blunt the edges: the record runs dark, dystopian, and dangerous from the first bar, with Greg Porn stalking the beat in full predatory mode. Somewhere in the two minutes there is a shout-out to Black Lansky, a reminder that the CWI machine is in the room even when the track is at its most feral. The genre is rap and hip hop rendered as underground trap, the dark trap end of Greg Porn's range: nocturnal, menacing, and hypnotic, with a late-night chill that curdles into something cold. Production is 808-driven and bass-heavy — distorted 808s pressing through a sparse arrangement of atmospheric pads and vocal chops — while stuttering hi-hats keep the tension wired throughout. The mix stays raw and reverb-heavy, letting the vocals sit exposed underneath the hook, over a bassline that feels like pursuit. For fans of dark trap, 'Unholy Hunter' is the sound the subgenre promises but rarely delivers: pure pursuit music, aggressive and serious about its own threat. It recalls the tension of 'On Edge' and sits alongside 'Pay Yourself' as the third chapter of Greg Porn's CWI run. When the final mix of the upcoming single lands, it will close that run as its darkest statement — until then, Ref 1.0 is the document: unreleased, unpolished, and hunting at full throttle. It sounds like a threat recorded before the paperwork caught up.
